output.summary: The evidence points to the temporary Brightwater venue, not programming, as the main driver of the decline. The cathedral comparison and the exit survey support this. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the move year, against about 9% for peers, and engaged subscribers renewed steadily at about 85%. Within Brightwater, concerts with post-1945 works sold the same as those without. Peers lost a similar share of revenue (median -29%), so the size of the decline is not unusual, though the shape differs. Whether Castellan would have fallen far less is unestablished. Marketing effect is unknown because nothing is attributed. Non-renewal would forfeit the $400k per season Halvorsen grant and risks the Arts Council grant. Present a segmented analysis and use the cathedral dates and a shuttle.
